note: This file is an MMPreTrain configuration script with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It imports base configs and overrides hyperparameters for training a ConvNeXt-XLarge model on ImageNet-1K at 384px resolution.
summary: Config-only file — variable assignments and framework config overrides. No CLI-invocable code.
use_cases: Load this config with MMEngine to train ConvNeXt-XLarge on ImageNet-1K
Override learning rate and batch size for distributed training on 64 GPUs
Enable EMA (Exponential Moving Average) hook with momentum 4e-5
Set gradient clipping with max_norm=5.0 for stable training
Auto-scale learning rate based on actual batch size relative to 4096
